project_description: Replace Go-LIP stream-time financial accounting with domain-neutral Turn/Leg Usage Records and a durable Bun-backed double-entry billing journal. Before upstream work, calculate a pessimistic maximum customer charge and atomically record an authorization hold against prepaid funds or a postpaid credit line. Execute with no financial mutation, then persist immutable A-leg/B-leg usage records with explicit durable identities and semantic replay fingerprints. Post-turn processing validates bound pricing/rate snapshots, calculates customer revenue and per-B-leg operator cost, posts balanced account-sequenced financial and authorization journal entries, records point-in-time account snapshots, closes the hold, and updates rebuildable materialized state. Journal replay by durable account sequence must reconstruct account state; integrity/reconciliation failures fail closed through an audited reconcile-required state.
